DEMO — fictional candidate

As Operations Manager at Acme Corp, I lead a support operation of 12 people handling 4,000+ tickets a month.

I redesigned how tickets were routed to the team. The change took first response time from 8 minutes to under 3.

What I took from it is that a slow first response can be a routing problem rather than a staffing one, and that a routing change can be measured on the same response-time figure the team already reports.
